sequence: 1x only: load until ready (interact.load.ready-ms), library Add, wait for the waveform and quiet (interact.harness.hook-live)
clip click: empty Stems lane click deselects (Clip Gain fader disabled), then a click on the clip header (interact.click.*, interact.harness.click-live)
zoom with 1 clip: 5 x "=" then 5 x "-", one window per key (interact.zoom.1.*, interact.harness.zoom-live)
drags stopped: range, fade-in, trim start, move; 60 steps, +120 px; reset after each (interact.drag.<d>.stopped.*)
drag background-range stopped: press on an empty lane background of another lane; 60 steps, +120 px; reset with a click on the clip name bar (interact.drag.background-range.stopped.*)

lane drag stopped: press on the clip name bar; 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; 1 step down into the next lane, then 10 steps +40 px there; 1 step back up, then 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; release; reset with Ctrl+Z (interact.drag.lane.stopped.*, interact.harness.drag-lane-live)
Home (seek to 0), then Space -> playing (interact.play.start-*, 1x: interact.harness.audio-running)
drags playing, each after Home (seek to 0): range, fade-in, trim start, move (interact.drag.<d>.playing.*)

lane drag playing, after Home (seek to 0): press on the clip name bar; 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; 1 step down into the next lane, then 10 steps +40 px there; 1 step back up, then 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; release; reset with Ctrl+Z (interact.drag.lane.playing.*, interact.harness.drag-lane-live)
group setup: click the clip name bar, Ctrl+D (a copy right after it), Ctrl+click the name bar of the first clip (2 clips selected)

group drag stopped: press on the first clip's name bar; 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; 1 step down into the next lane, then 10 steps +40 px there; 1 step back up, then 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; release; reset with Ctrl+Z (interact.drag.group.stopped.*, interact.harness.drag-group-live)
group drag playing: Space, then the same gesture after Home (seek to 0); reset with Ctrl+Z; Space (interact.drag.group.playing.*, interact.harness.drag-group-live)
group teardown: Ctrl+Z (the Ctrl+D copy is removed; 1 clip, Undo back at its start entry)

1x only: click the clip header, Ctrl+D x 29 (interact.harness.clips-30), zoom with 30 clips: keys, then the in-first path (5 x "=", 5 x "-") and the out-first path (5 x "-", 5 x "=") with the zoom probe (interact.zoom.30.*, interact.zoom.30.in/out.*), Space, Home, fade-in drag on the first clip (interact.drag.fade.30.playing.*), Space, then Ctrl+wheel out-first (5 x deltaY +100, 5 x -100) with the zoom probe (interact.zoom.30.wheel.*)

1x only, after the 30-clip block: "-" until 2 clip name bars are visible (at most 16), click one name bar (setup), then click the name bar of a visible, unselected clip on the selected clip's lane, then click it again (interact.select.same-lane.30.*, interact.select.reclick.30.*, interact.harness.select-same-lane-live)

1x only, measured last: import public/videos/hero/1.mp4 through the video lane input (1 video clip at 0, Undo "Add video"), "=" until its name bar is at least 480 px wide (at most 16 keys); stopped: move drag on the video clip name bar, trim-start drag, fade-in drag; then Space and the same three drags, each after Home (seek to 0), Space; reset after each with Ctrl+Z; teardown Ctrl+Z (0 video clips, Undo back at its start entry) (interact.drag.video.*, interact.drag.video-trim.*, interact.drag.video-fade.*, interact.harness.drag-video-live, interact.harness.drag-video-trim-live, interact.harness.drag-video-fade-live)
